The charcoal hollow, and the one warm place on the road. Sootmoth is the rare slot and it is on this table and on no other table north of Emberfall, which is the whole reason the branch exists: a Kin that lives in chimneys and warm caves is out here because there is a kiln in the middle of this clearing that has not been out since 1102, and a player who walks in and works that out has been told something about the world by the encounter table rather than by a person.

Sheltered ground, so the band is a shade higher than the road outside it -- 30-34 -- and the table is otherwise the pine wood: Beast in the undergrowth, one Chitin, one Verdant/Stone on the bark.
